test_ShLexer_basic: test the ShLexer class to tokenize a shell command string into tokens and operators
test_ShLexer_quoting: test the ShLexer class to handle single quotes, double quotes, and escape sequences in shell strings
test_ShParser_basic: test the ShParser class to parse a simple shell command into a Pipeline of Commands
test_ShParser_redirection: test the ShParser class to parse shell redirections like >, >>, and 2>&1
test_ShParser_pipeline: test the ShParser class to parse shell pipelines with | and list operators like ;, &&, ||
